title: dactylis glomerata subsp. hylodes
intro: Dactylis glomerata subsp. hylodes, commonly known as Orchard Grass, is a subspecies of a perennial grass native to Europe. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it useful in the treatment of various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Dactylis glomerata subsp. hylodes are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including phenolic acids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its anti-inflammatory and immune-modulating effects. However, more research is needed to confirm the specific health benefits and therapeutic actions of this plant.
